errors.quote: elevated vantage of K2's north face
errors.why: The source only says the view of K2 is more spectacular than from Concordia; from Broad Peak BC on the Baltoro side the visible face is the south face (also in Day 11: "direct view of K2's north face").

errors.quote: Named by mountaineer Martin Conway after the Piazza della Concordia in Rome
errors.why: Source says Conway named it after the place de la Concordia in Paris.

errors.quote: a six-hour jeep journey departs for Jhola at 3,140 meters via Askoli
errors.why: Source gives about six hours Skardu to Askoli, with the road then extended further to Jhola; six hours is not the time to Jhola.

errors.quote: Finishing through Hushe Valley and Khaplu: traditional gateway villages of Baltistan's high-altitude porter and guide community
errors.why: Source calls Hushe the gateway village of porters; Khaplu is only a short stop on the jeep drive, described as an old Baltistan kingdom.

errors.quote: Alpine crossing of the Karakoram's highest passes
errors.why: The route crosses one pass (Gondogoro La); the source never calls it the Karakoram's highest passes.

errors.quote: traverses the Karakoram's most challenging high-altitude terrain
errors.why: Source says one of the most demanding treks on earth, not the Karakoram's most challenging terrain.

errors.quote: weather, permits, and porter availability are subject to seasonal conditions
errors.why: Porter availability as a seasonal constraint is not in the source.

errors.quote: Four-hour run from Fishling to Mugling on Class III–IV rapids
errors.why: The source gives no rapid grade; Class III–IV repeats in summary, highlights, itinerary and seo_meta.

errors.quote: sections of open water suitable for swimmers and less experienced paddlers
errors.why: Source makes no suitability statement for swimmers or less experienced paddlers; it stresses extreme rapids.

errors.quote: delivers a full-day run of intermediate whitewater
errors.why: Source describes 'extreme rapids'; 'intermediate' is an invented difficulty that contradicts it.

errors.quote: onward connection to Pokhara or Chitwan
errors.why: Source only says you can return to Kathmandu, Chitwan or Pokhara after rafting; it does not include onward transport (also in highlight 'Return logistics ... the same day').

errors.quote: Riverbank lunch break on a sandy beach between paddle sections
errors.why: Source mentions a lunch on the river bank; 'sandy beach' is not stated, and the inclusions say lunch is served after the rafting.

errors.quote: moderate climbing difficulty
errors.why: The source gives no difficulty grade.

errors.quote: a 30-minute walk ascends from the entrance to reach Watchtower 8, where the formal wall begins
errors.why: Source: 30 minutes from the entrance to the Wall, then about 30 more minutes up stairs to Watchtower 8 (about an hour in total).

errors.quote: this section connected the capital's northern defense line with the imperial tombs
errors.why: Source says the section was the northern barrier defending the capital and the imperial tombs, not a link between them.

errors.quote: The site contains three main excavation pits, each revealing roughly 2,000 of an estimated 6,000 clay figures
errors.why: Source: just under 2,000 warriors in total are visible across the three pits, not about 2,000 per pit.

errors.quote: with a local guide all in one full
errors.why: Meta stops mid-phrase ('one full ...').

errors.quote: Activity duration: approximately 6–7 hours on the water
errors.why: Source gives Day 9 kayaking as 3-4 hrs / 10 km, with lunch ashore; 6-7 hours on the water misstates the paddling load a customer plans around.

errors.quote: Tiger Cave Temple's golden Buddha at 600 metres elevation
errors.why: Source gives 600 m up/down for the day's hike (elevation gain), not the temple's altitude.

errors.quote: Activity duration: approximately 3 hours. Terrain: calm mangrove channels; experience level: beginner to intermediate
errors.why: Source gives no experience level for the Koh Yao Yai paddle (and gives 3-4 hrs).

errors.quote: the Grand Palace and its Emerald Buddha are walkable from your hotel
errors.why: Source only suggests the Grand Palace as a sight to visit; it does not say it is walkable from the Chinatown hotel.

errors.quote: Travel time: approximately 12 hours.
errors.why: Source gives no train journey time.

errors.quote: passing through villages, rubber plantations, and coconut groves
errors.why: Source says a rubber and palm plantation; no coconut groves on Day 4.

errors.quote: Transfer time: approximately 2 hours from Khao Sok.
errors.why: Source gives 2.5 hrs driving on Day 5.

errors.quote: a local guide leads a nocturnal hike through the forest canopy
errors.why: The night hike is on the forest floor; nothing in the source puts it in the canopy.

errors.quote: Evening brings a shuttle to Ao Nang for dinner and a visit to the night market.
errors.why: Source says sunset cocktails and the night market; dinner at Ao Nang is not stated (only 4 dinners are included).

errors.quote: Thailand by Water, Rail & Trail — 9 Days
errors.why: The page's itinerary runs Day 1 to Day 10 (the source summary says 10-day, nights add to 9); the 9-day label and 10 day blocks need reconciling.

errors.quote: Transfer to the airport for your flight home.
errors.why: Day 10 repeats the airport transfer sentence.

errors.quote:
Day 7 — Departure
Your journey through Sri Lanka's natural wonders concludes.
errors.why: A departure day is inserted mid-trip on Day 7; source Days 6-7 are in Kitulgala and the trip ends on Day 17.

errors.quote: Day 3 — Bentota to Galle and Yala
errors.why: Source keeps Days 1-3 in Bentota and Days 4-5 in Yala, Days 6-7 Kitulgala; the page moves Yala to Day 3 and Kitulgala to Day 5, so overnights no longer match the source.

errors.quote: Guides use 4x4 vehicles and track animals on foot.
errors.why: Source offers guided safaris only; tracking animals on foot is an activity the source never offers.

errors.quote: Sri Lanka: Coast, Rainforest & Mountain — 17 Days
errors.why: Source is a luxury family adventure recommended for families with young adults (excursions suitable for children over 12); the page drops the family and luxury theme and the 12+ suitability.

errors.quote: The route is open year-round but optimal between November and March.
errors.why: Source only says good during November to March; 'open year-round' is not stated.

errors.quote: Day 5 — Yala National Park Morning Safari
errors.why: Source gives an afternoon and a morning safari; the page has two morning safaris.

errors.quote: Safari duration is typically 4 to 5 hours.
errors.why: Source gives no safari duration.

errors.quote: learning net casting and trap techniques
errors.why: Source only says traditional fishing with a local fisherman.

errors.quote: Duration is 6 to 7 hours of active walking.
errors.why: Source gives no trek duration for the Knuckles.

errors.quote: a transfer from the Knuckles mountains westward toward the central plateau and then to Sigiriya
errors.why: Sigiriya lies north of the Knuckles range, not west; the drive time (2-3 hours) is also not in the source.

errors.quote: Day 12 — Cycling and Scenic Picnic near Sigiriya
errors.why: Source has one cycle to Sigiriya Rock, the climb, then a cycle to a picnic; the page repeats the cycle to the Rock on Day 12 after the climb on Day 11.

errors.quote: Private transfer from Colombo airport to Bentota, a coastal town on the south shore. Upon arrival in Sri Lanka our chauffeur will transfer you to Bentota
errors.why: Day 1 states the same transfer twice (second sentence copied from the source).

errors.quote: The route is accessible for all cycling levels.
errors.why: Source states no elevation gain but makes no suitability claim for all levels.

errors.quote: wild boar
errors.why: Source lists tigers, leopards, Bengal foxes, langurs, deer, birds, monkeys; wild boar is not mentioned.

errors.quote: These pillars reflect the Jain principle of ahimsa, non-violence toward all living beings.
errors.why: Source states Jains believe in ahimsa; it does not link the 1,444 pillars to ahimsa.

errors.quote: Block printing workshop with artisans in Jaipur and Chandelao
errors.why: Only Jaipur (Anoothi) is a hands-on block printing activity; Pipar near Chandelao is a village visit to meet families practising the craft.

errors.quote: Start before dawn with a 12-kilometer bicycle ride
errors.why: Source says the ride starts the day; 'before dawn' is not stated.

errors.quote: Chaukhamba and Trishul frame the western horizon
errors.why: Source gives no compass directions; Trishul lies to the south-east of Kuari Pass, not west.

errors.quote: Chaukhamba (left behind to the south)
errors.why: Source gives no direction; Chaukhamba lies north-west of Akhod Getha/Gulling, not south.

errors.quote: following traditional shepherd routes through the landscape
errors.why: Source mentions shepherds at the meadow, not that the trail follows shepherd routes.

errors.quote: Route connects.
errors.why: Meta ends with an unfinished phrase.

errors.quote: The evening returns to the hot spring hotel, where thermal baths and spa facilities are available.
errors.why: Source Day 5 is titled Yuli Hot Springs and ends 'at a historic hot spring hotel' (a different stay); the page implies a second night at the Ruisui hotel, and the summary's 'hot spring hotels in Ruisui and Mudan' drops Yuli. Spa facilities are not in the source.

errors.quote: a hot spring hotel with direct access to thermal pools
errors.why: Source only says hot spring hotel in Ruisui; 'direct access to thermal pools' is an invented amenity.

errors.quote: visit night markets in Hualien and Taipei
errors.why: Source names only Dadongmen Night Market (Hualien); in Taipei it is a stroll through a shopping district.

errors.quote: at a local Hunter's School in Kiwit Village
errors.why: Source lists the Hunter's School and a walking tour with foot bath in Kiwit separately; it does not place the school in Kiwit.

errors.quote: Visit the Indigenous Wild Vegetable Center near Liyu Lake
errors.why: Source does not say where the Wild Vegetable Center is.

errors.quote: descending 1,570 meters over 126 kilometers
errors.why: In the source stage format (km / m / hrs) 1,570 m is the day's climbing, as the page itself reads 456 m on Day 7; presenting it as descent hides 1,570 m of climbing a rider plans around.

errors.quote: Arrival in Lishan comes as the day's light fades
errors.why: Source says arrival at Lishan in the afternoon.

errors.quote: ranking among the best bike tours in Taiwan
errors.why: Source makes no ranking claim about this tour.

errors.quote: hands-on time with rescued and rehabilitated elephants
errors.why: Source says you learn about the hospital and become acquainted with resident patients; it never offers hands-on contact (the page's own itinerary says 'observing').

errors.quote: Khao Phraya River cruise
errors.why: The river is the Chao Phraya.

errors.quote: You'll spend nights in a Hmong village lodge
errors.why: Source has one night at the Hmong Lodge.

errors.quote: are built into each day's rhythm
errors.why: Source includes only the meals listed per day; exclusions say meals unless specified are not included.

errors.quote: between Nam Tok and Kanchanaburi stations
errors.why: Source says boarding at Nam Tok; the end station is not stated.

errors.quote: Thailand's three most distinct regions
errors.why: Source makes no such claim.

errors.quote: Stay overnight at Rombuk monastery (5,000 m)
errors.why: Source puts the night at the Rombuk guesthouse, not in the monastery.

errors.quote: which sits directly across a valley from Mount Everest's north face
errors.why: Source: the view is directly up the valley to Base Camp and Everest, not across a valley.

errors.quote: The descent to Kathmandu is a long drive on roads in variable condition.
errors.why: Source warns much of the road is in very bad condition; the page softens a condition travellers plan around.

errors.quote: Mount Kailash kora at 5,200m
errors.why: Source gives Drolma-la at 5,630 m and Dirapuk at 5,210 m; the kora is not described as at 5,200 m.
